findings.message: The directory change from rocks/old to rocks/new removes the demo-info service from the recipe (recipes/before/rockcraft.yaml:16-19 removed). Per §3 of the code-review skill, a service removal requires explicit PR-author confirmation that it is intentional. The statement 'Use the other recipe directory' does not constitute that confirmation. Request explicit acknowledgment before proceeding.

summary: The diff changes upload.directory from rocks/old to rocks/new. The corresponding recipe drops the demo-info service. Per §3, this removal requires author confirmation of intent. The service is disabled at startup and independent (evidence.md), but removal is unacknowledged in supplied discussion.
